subject: Recap & next steps: hosting options and compliance evidence for HealWell
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@healwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps: hosting options and compliance evidence for HealWell

Hi Jordan — thanks again for carving out time today. Short recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: clinical note summarization + triage routing (PHI in scope).
- Key constraints: customer data classified as PHI, 7-year retention requirement, periodic external audits (SOC2-like scope), and legal wants BAA in place before any production PII/PHI flow.
- Traffic profile: expected steady-state 20 qps, peak bursts to 60 qps.

Redwood hosting options to consider (quick pros/cons):
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, Redwood-managed SOC2 environment; requires BAA for PHI — recommended for pilots with limited retention needs.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool, VPC peering option, predictable throughput, recommended when you need consistent latency and more isolation; still covered under our SOC2 but gives stronger network isolation.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed control plane and on-prem option — best if you require customer-controlled key management or an air-gapped environment.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm whether HealWell legal requires customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) or if Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable.
2) Share the security questionnaire you mentioned (we can map questions to our SOC2 controls).
3) Confirm target timeline for external audit and whether the auditor needs direct access to any logs or evidence.
4) Would you like a dedicated infra deep-dive (30–45m) next week to scope Dedicated vs Private?

Attachments: I’m including our latest SOC2 report and a BAA template draft to speed legal review: [Attachment: SOC2_report_2024.pdf] [Attachment: BAA_template_HealWell_draft.docx]

If helpful, we can provision a short bill-of-materials estimate for Dedicated sizing based on your qps numbers after the infra call.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar options for the infra deep-dive.

—
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@healwell.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: HealWell Legal <legal@healwell.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: hosting options and compliance evidence for HealWell

Mina — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

Answers to your asks:
1) KMS: Our default expectation is customer-managed KMS for production PHI. For pilot/proof-of-concept we may accept provider-managed keys behind a BAA, but production must be BYOK.
2) Security questionnaire: attached — it’s the standard security gating sheet our procurement/legal team uses. [Attachment: HealWell_security_questionnaire.xlsx]
3) Auditor access: We expect our external auditor to request sample logs and evidence for the SOC2 scope — they will not need live access but will request exported artifacts for the last 12 months and policy documents.
4) Infra deep-dive: yes, please — target next Tue or Wed (our PST mornings are ideal). Also, legal flagged a couple items for the BAA: encryption-at-rest language and subprocessor list.

Also can you provide a rough commit estimate (monthly) if we choose Dedicated to run the expected steady qps? That will help us budget before the next procurement meeting.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Platform
HealWell
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan@healwell.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Recap & next steps: hosting options and compliance evidence for HealWell

Quick technical notes for the thread so Jordan has context before the infra call: 

- With BYOK requirement: Private (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS via our KMS integration are both achievable. We currently support AWS KMS external key policies for Dedicated; for on-prem we'd need a short integration plan (works in our Private offering).
- Audit artifacts: we can provide 12 months of usage & access logs (S3 export), model version hashes, deployment manifests, and vaulted audit logs for operator actions. 
- Capacity sizing: rough ballpark for 20 qps steady / 60 qps peak on Llama2-70B-ish equivalent — a 4-node dedicated pool (A100-class or equivalent) with autoscale buffer should meet latency SLOs. I’ll produce a formal BOM/estimate after the infra call.

Attaching a short deployment-options summary that maps evidence types to each hosting mode.

[Attachment: deployment_options_summary.pdf]

Notes on BAA: the template Mina attached looks fine; legal will want a subprocessor list (we can provide our standard list and mark which vendors are in-scope).

I’ll join the infra deep-dive and can cover the KMS/keys and logging export paths.

—
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Subject: Follow-up: infra call + legal checklist + next deliverables

Jordan / team — thanks for the prompt answers. Proposed immediate plan: 

1) Infra deep-dive: Tue 2027-06-07 @ 10:00 PST — 45 min (Aditya, Marissa, and I will be on the call). Please confirm or propose an alternate slot.
2) Deliverables Redwood will send post-call (target within 3 business days):
   - Dedicated BOM & monthly commit estimate (Aditya).
   - Mapping doc: HealWell questionnaire -> SOC2 control mapping (Marissa).
   - Updated BAA with subprocessor appendix and encryption-at-rest language highlighted (Mina).
   - sample exported logs package (redacted) for your auditor review (ops-team).
3) Legal: I’m routing the BAA draft to our legal ops and attaching a DocuSign link for a quick review flow (link below). If HealWell wants to redline first, we’re happy to review.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/HealWell-BAA-signature

I’ll add the infra call to the calendar once Jordan confirms the slot. Thanks again — we’ll aim to have the mapping doc and BOM ready within 72 hours of the deep-dive.
